scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix MediaTagger.Electron && npm install --prefix mediaTagger.client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "API,React,Electron" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mediaTagger.client && dotnet publish MediaTagger.API -c Release -o MediaTagger.API/bin/publish
